sentences.en: We are always aiming at improving the quality of service.
sentences.zh: 我们始终致力于提高服务质量。

sentences.en: Doctors can be wrong, and some patients can suddenly improve.
sentences.zh: 医生可能会犯错，有些病人可以突然好转。

sentences.en: The situation has improved considerably compared with what it was.
sentences.zh: 与过去相比，情况有了显著改善。

senses.zh: 使更好，改进，利用，(提高)价值
